explication: The repository defines GenAI OpenTelemetry conventions and includes Python reference scenarios that emit telemetry to demonstrate convention coverage. The principal workflow is scenario execution, shared telemetry setup, then conformance evaluation and support reporting. The README also identifies spans, metrics, events, MCP, and provider-specific conventions as product capabilities; their convention definitions and human-readable docs are described but are not present in the supplied tree.
